title: Undeciphered

Appaṭividitasutta Undeciphered

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

Ekamantaṁ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi: Standing to one side, that deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:

“Yesaṁ dhammā appaṭividitā, “Those have not deciphered the teachings Paravādesu nīyare; may be led astray by the doctrines of others. Suttā te nappabujjhanti, Asleep, they have not woken up: Kālo tesaṁ pabujjhitun”ti. it is time for them to wake!”

“Yesaṁ dhammā suppaṭividitā, “Those who have well deciphered the teachings Paravādesu na nīyare; won’t be led astray by the doctrines of others. Te sambuddhā sammadaññā, They have woken up, they rightly know, Caranti visame saman”ti. smoothly they walk in the rough.”
